title: Recoverable Depreciation and Storage Extension Figures — Insurance Claim Services
content:
Carrier liaison figures for Insurance Claim Services files: the window for asking the carrier to release recoverable depreciation, who asks, and the limits on asking the carrier to extend paid contents storage.

## Terms

- **Depreciation request window** — calendar days after the first ACV payment within which the company or insured requests release of recoverable depreciation, count.
- **Release requires completion** — whether the release request requires the related job to be complete, boolean.
- **Company requests depreciation** — whether the company submits the depreciation release request itself, boolean.
- **Storage extension requests allowed** — whether the company may ask the carrier to extend the approved contents storage end date, boolean.
- **Storage extension maximum** — longest extension of the storage end date asked for in one request, calendar days.
- **Storage extension lead days** — calendar days before the approved storage end date by which an extension request must be submitted, count.

## Figures

| Arrangement | Depreciation window (days) | Requires completion | Company requests | Extensions allowed | Extension maximum (days) | Lead days |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support | 180 | yes | no | no | 0 | 0 |
| Direction to Pay Claim Billing | 180 | yes | yes | yes | 60 | 14 |
| Assignment of Benefits Claim Billing | 180 | yes | yes | yes | 60 | 14 |
| Carrier Program Claim Billing | 180 | yes | yes | yes | 30 | 14 |
| Public Adjuster Coordinated Claim Billing | 180 | yes | no | no | 0 | 0 |
| Commercial Large Loss Claim Administration | 365 | yes | yes | yes | 90 | 21 |

On Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support and Public Adjuster Coordinated Claim Billing the company neither requests depreciation itself nor asks for storage extensions. Commercial Large Loss Claim Administration carries the longest depreciation window (365 days), the longest extension (90 days) and the longest lead time (21 days).
